name: carpetstory
description: Search the Carpetstory catalogue of hand-knotted rugs made to order in Jaipur, India.
long_description: Find rugs from the live Carpetstory catalogue by motif, mood, colour or collection, and get each rug's materials, knot density, lead time, image and product page. Read-only, no API key.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the current rug collections with materials, knot density and lead time.

tools.name: search_rugs
tools.description: Search rugs by words, collection or colour family.
